The structure of SrAg₂P₂O₆ (Sr₄Ag₈P₈O₂₄ per cell) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 44 atoms distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination throughout: Ag centers are octahedrally coordinated by six O neighbors, P centers by six O neighbors, and Sr centers by six O neighbors, while each O center has four geometric neighbors (one Ag, one P, two Sr). The analysis further shows corner-sharing between Ag–P, Ag–Sr, and P–Sr octahedra, with additional edge-sharing between Ag–Ag octahedra, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
